verdict.rationale: Reducto ships a documented public API (OpenAPI spec confirmed at openapi.json) covering parse, extract, split, classify, edit/fill, async job workflows, webhooks, and configuration options, plus SDK code examples throughout the docs and a quickstart. It also has a CLI and MCP server that let agents drive the same capabilities programmatically. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer confirmation of API ergonomics/completeness beyond first-party docs.
